title: A sharp forest bound and an improved whisker bound for finite WARM graphs
strongest_verified_result: For every finite simple undirected loopless WARM graph with positive vertex rates and fixed positive integer initial counts, E_infinity is almost surely a forest for alpha>4/3; for equal rates it is almost surely a whisker forest for alpha>=17/4. At every odd support cycle of length m, instability holds for alpha>sec^2(pi/(2m)), with arbitrary rates/weights/chords/attachments. Equal-rate unit-initialized triangles have positive probability of all three edges surviving for each1<alpha<4/3.
exact_scope_limits: No sharp whisker conclusion in4/3<alpha<17/4;17/4 is sufficient only.
Equal rates required for the whisker conclusion.
No infinite graphs, loops, initial zero edges, or positive noninteger initial offsets.
Initialization conditioning transfers almost-sure tail assertions, not stable-point attainment to every initial vector.
imported_results: HHK2023 published Theorem1 finite convergence/non-instability and strictly stable attainment; Proposition1 support identification. Exact model and hypotheses checked, full upstream proofs accepted as standard published imports.
Prior2016 uniform odd-cycle/triangle threshold and2017 least-weight/champion mechanism credited.
